title: A builder’s perspective on software quality.
description: I’m Kiran Dhakal, a computer engineer in Kathmandu transitioning from full-stack development into software quality assurance.

sections.title: From development to QA
paragraphs: My CV reflects 2+ years of full-stack development across municipal services, education, retail, and content management. That experience helps me connect what users see with APIs, databases, and business rules.
The testing approaches on this site are portfolio exercises informed by my development work, rather than claims of previous QA employment.

sections.title: Information Care Pvt. Ltd.
paragraphs: My development contributions include Dhangadhi Service Bus, Hello Palika, Vibe College, CTF School Management, Chiurika, Connect Kisan, Syanko POS, and Dwarika Engineering. I have worked on configurable workflows, forms, notifications, payments, reporting, and responsive interfaces.

sections.title: Education & interests
paragraphs: Bachelor of Computer Engineering, Gandaki College of Engineering and Science, Pokhara — 2020–2025, as listed in my CV.
I speak Nepali, English, and Hindi. I enjoy strategic chess, open-source development, and exploring web technologies.
